scope: Conditional text similarity/representations and relevance to JEP hearing retrieval
status: bounded systematic lane; not an exhaustive global systematic review

included_primary_papers.title: C-STS: Conditional Semantic Textual Similarity
included_primary_papers.data: English image-caption-derived sentence pairs; human conditional scalar ratings
included_primary_papers.method: Arbitrary relevant natural-language conditions; cross/bi/tri encoders and paired high/low condition objectives.
included_primary_papers.limit: Task specificity already exists. Caption-derived ratings do not establish evidence-grounded harm interpretation or expert testimony retrieval.
included_primary_papers.novelty_counterexample: Natural-language moral conditioning is an application of an existing task.
included_primary_papers.relevance: Use paired condition-switch tests, but require separate JEP relevance labels.

included_primary_papers.title: Linguistically Conditioned Semantic Textual Similarity
included_primary_papers.data: Human reannotation of English C-STS validation; four trained annotators
included_primary_papers.method: Rules distinguish binary comparisons, ambiguity, inference degree and invalid conditions; QA-derived answers support error identification and training.
included_primary_papers.limit: It already addresses implicit/missing condition evidence; invalid instances are excluded rather than retained as an uncertainty-aware retrieval target.
included_primary_papers.novelty_counterexample: Condition-grounded extraction or missing-information awareness is not wholly new.
included_primary_papers.relevance: Extend toward explicit/inferred/unknown harm statuses with evidence spans and expert disagreement, rather than merely discarding unknowns.

included_primary_papers.title: Hyper-CL: Conditioning Sentence Representations with Hypernetworks
included_primary_papers.method: Condition embedding generates a linear sentence projection; contrastive training, low-rank parameterization and cached condition networks.
included_primary_papers.limit: Efficient condition-specific subspaces are established; these experiments do not test JEP expert relevance or uncertain harm evidence.
included_primary_papers.novelty_counterexample: A condition-generated projection is prior art.
included_primary_papers.relevance: Strong amortized baseline for many expert-selected criteria on a fixed testimony corpus.

included_primary_papers.title: Varying Sentence Representations via Condition-Specified Routers
included_primary_papers.method: Condition queries reweight sentence token hidden states within transformer blocks; trades interaction quality against reusable representations.
included_primary_papers.limit: Routing salient tokens and efficient repeated conditioning are covered; no testimony-specific evidence sufficiency evaluation in inspected experiments.
included_primary_papers.novelty_counterexample: Condition-sensitive attention/routing is already a method family.
included_primary_papers.relevance: Benchmark response time, cached storage and expert retrieval quality under changing JEP criteria.

included_primary_papers.title: SEAVER: Attention Reallocation for Mitigating Distractions in Language Models for Conditional Semantic Textual Similarity Measurement
included_primary_papers.authors: Baixuan Li, Yunlong Fan, Zhiqiang Gao
included_primary_papers.data: C-STS-2023; supervised English conditional pair ratings
included_primary_papers.method: Extracts sentence–condition attention submatrices, constructs reweighting signals, augments hidden states, and scores with a regressor.
included_primary_papers.limit: Already targets dilution by irrelevant features. Cross-encoding is not interchangeable with cached shared embeddings for retrieval.
included_primary_papers.novelty_counterexample: Attention-based removal of irrelevant context is not novel.
included_primary_papers.relevance: Use as a targeted pairwise reranking baseline, with corpus-scale cost measured separately.

included_primary_papers.title: Conditional Semantic Textual Similarity via Conditional Contrastive Learning
included_primary_papers.data: C-STS; bi/tri encoder experiments across five backbones
included_primary_papers.method: Weighted adaptive and balanced contrastive losses combined with score regression address over-optimization and hard/controversial negatives.
included_primary_papers.limit: Hard-negative balancing is established, but requires meaningful similarity targets. Expert-contested moral comparisons are not automatically false negatives.
included_primary_papers.novelty_counterexample: More perturbations or hard negatives alone do not establish novelty.
included_primary_papers.relevance: Preserve annotation uncertainty and use verified relational negatives rather than forcing every nearby case apart.

included_primary_papers.title: Annotating Training Data for Conditional Semantic Textual Similarity Measurement using Large Language Models
included_primary_papers.data: English C-STS conditions/ratings; original human and multiple LLM signals
included_primary_papers.method: Refines condition wording and reannotates ratings with few-shot justified LLM outputs; discusses sentence/condition split overlap.
included_primary_papers.limit: Cleaner task specification and overlap auditing are already contributions. Cleaned labels still require task-specific validity for JEP.
included_primary_papers.novelty_counterexample: Automatic annotation cleanup is prior art; the user's audited version should be retained, not replaced.
included_primary_papers.relevance: Use existing cleaned JEP cohorts and preserve original partitions and provenance.

included_primary_papers.title: CASE – Condition-Aware Sentence Embeddings for Conditional Semantic Textual Similarity Measurement
included_primary_papers.data: Existing English C-STS datasets and reannotations
included_primary_papers.method: Condition-token contextual pooling, condition subtraction, and shared supervised projection. §4.4 also evaluates LoRA-tuned Qwen3-Embedding-8B.
included_primary_papers.limit: English-only evaluation and unassessed social bias are explicit limitations. Conditional subtraction and Qwen C-STS adaptation are already covered.
included_primary_papers.novelty_counterexample: User's Qwen adaptation, small projections and condition subtraction cannot be claimed as new ingredients.
included_primary_papers.relevance: Essential baseline; strongest opportunity is testimony-specific validity and culturally grounded Spanish annotation.

included_primary_papers.title: Focusing Condition: Inference-Time Self-Contrastive Steering Elicits Better Conditional Text Embeddings in LLMs
included_primary_papers.data: Conditional clustering, STS and triplet tasks; AppendixE includes Spanish/German Amazon-review clustering
included_primary_papers.method: Masks condition with attention/position modifications, contrasts conditional/unconditional attention outputs, then steers activations. Studies intervention and output layers.
included_primary_papers.limit: Broad multilingual conditioning and layer analysis already exist. Spanish review clustering is not Spanish expert conditional-judgment validation.
included_primary_papers.novelty_counterexample: Generic contrastive steering, layerwise conditioning and Spanish transfer are not defensible broad gaps.
included_primary_papers.relevance: Use a faithful steering baseline if feasible; keep layer choice on development families and assess JEP evidence/meaning preservation.

search_log.purpose: Core methods and backward/forward citation leads
Authoritative verification and gap counterexample search

inclusion: Primary full-text methods or annotation papers directly studying conditional textual similarity, with inspected methods/evaluation sections.
exclusion: Generic STS-only benchmarks, secondary mirrors, vision-only condition networks, and dynamic RAG trigger papers where conditional retrieval means deciding whether to retrieve.
snowballing: Hyper-CL retrieved from CSR/CCL references; inspected CASE LoRA comparison and SCS appendices rather than relying on abstracts.

pending.title: Semantic Conditional Similarity (SCS): A Formal Mathematical Framework
pending.reason: Very recent Nov5 preprint; different apparent task formulation; passed to parent for mathematics-lane full-text screening. Not used as verified support.

gaps.claim: Retain explicit, inferred and unsupported harm evidence as distinct conditional retrieval states instead of forcing every pair onto one scalar or dropping unknown-condition cases.
gaps.confidence: moderate within inspected core; not a claim no broader uncertainty/NLI work exists
gaps.experiment: Expert-adjudicated evidence-status + relevance labels for held-out JEP families; compare full text, QA/extractive cards, conditional encoder and reranker. Measure unsupported-inference rate, selective Recall@k and coverage.

gaps.claim: Spanish/Colombian testimony-specific conditional judgments grounded in expert interpretations and evidence, including implicit harms and contested meanings.
gaps.confidence: moderate; Spanish conditional clustering already exists
gaps.experiment: Paired Spanish and independently reviewed English cases with role-preserving paraphrases, culturally specific implicit harms and unknown facts. Evaluate by family/language and expert disagreement; never treat translation agreement as cultural validity.

gaps.claim: Jointly test selective invariance and selective sensitivity under explicit normative interpretations on difficult cross-story retrieval, beyond easy surface-feature matching.
gaps.confidence: plausible JEP evaluation contribution; generic conditionality/negative sampling are established
gaps.experiment: Freeze paired variants with the same factual profile versus altered consent, intention, control or beneficiary roles. Add condition-aware lexical/factual parsers and oracle evidence controls; report worst-family failures, not only mean accuracy.

gaps.claim: Compare amortized condition projection/routing with expensive joint conditioning under changing expert criteria and real corpus-scale retrieval budgets.
gaps.confidence: useful application study; weak architectural novelty by itself
gaps.experiment: Hold source passages and expert relevance fixed; measure Recall@k, latency, storage, update cost and coverage when conditions change. Avoid comparing only model parameter counts.

not_gaps: Condition subtraction/residualization as a generic idea
Spanish conditional representation transfer in general
More synthetic negatives without task-specific validity
